test_title: SSC CGL 2022 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On : 08 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

One has to ________ the risks associated with global warming.
solution:
The correct answer is **"bear in mind".**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• There is a **blank given** in **the sentence** which we **need to fill up** **with a correct word**.
 
• **To bear** **anything** is to **put up with it**, **typically something you detest.**
 
• The meaning of the given sentence is **one must be aware of the dangers posed by global warming.**

**​Correct sentence: **One has to **bear in mind__** the risks associated with global warming.
